defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open task-linked form, persist its canonical instance, mark it completed through the app execution store, then open the artifact route.
defects.expected_result: Completed form instance opens a reviewable immutable completed/signed artifact, not a blank template or no-preview state.
defects.actual_result: Viewer reports signed artifact is not available in this session.
defects.recommended_fix: Create a durable completed/signed snapshot whenever a form reaches terminal status and make Artifact Viewer retrieve it from the canonical artifact store.
